MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 2, 4, 6
   B. 1, 6
   C. 3, 6, 9
   D. 1, 2, 3, 6

2. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 8
   D. 16

3. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

4. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

5. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. They are equal
   C. 1/2
   D. 1/4

6. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/4
   B. 3/4
   C. 1/2
   D. 2/3

7. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 25
   C. 2
   D. 1

8. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

9. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 31

10. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x + 2
   B. 12x
   C. 6x
   D. 6x + 2

11. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31.7
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31

12. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 30
   C. 105
   D. 44

13. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.025
   B. 0.25
   C. 0.205
   D. 2.5

14. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/4
   C. They are equal
   D. 2/2

15. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15.6
   B. 21
   C. 15.7
   D. 15

16. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23
   B. 23.7
   C. 23.6
   D. 29

17. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 46
   C. 120
   D. 23

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 8 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 38
   B. 88
   C. 19
   D. 22

19. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 7 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 22
   C. 18
   D. 77

20. What is √64? (1 mark)
   A. 64
   B. 9
   C. 32
   D. 8

21. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x < 5
   C. x > 5
   D. x = 5

22. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 43
   C. 2
   D. 1

23. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.6
   B. 19.7
   C. 19
   D. 25

24. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
